title: add-retry-to-fetch
description: Add exponential backoff retry to a thin fetch wrapper and cover it with a unit test.

messages.content: Add retry with exponential backoff to our fetch wrapper in src/http/fetchWithRetry.ts. Keep the public API stable, retry only on network errors and 429/5xx, and add a small unit test.
I will inspect the existing fetch wrapper and nearby tests, then add bounded exponential backoff for transient failures only.

arguments.command: ls -la src/http && rg -n fetchWithRetry src test --glob *.ts

messages.name: Read
messages.content: export async function fetchWithRetry(input, init) { return fetch(input, init); }
The wrapper is a thin pass-through. Next I will check the test setup and implement retries with exponential backoff.
Implementing retry backoff in the wrapper and adding a focused unit test with a mock fetch.
Running the unit test to verify retry behavior.
Done. fetchWithRetry now retries on network errors and 429/5xx with exponential backoff (default 3 retries, 100ms base). Public API stays stable; unit test confirms 503 then 200.
